examined.reason: Add separately scheduled native guard simulation in both directions, exact physical instruction positions, inherited tree results and complete fetched input-loop correctness/existence. Keep joint concurrent source admission and output/solver composition explicitly unfinished.
Describe the completed native-tree and scalar-input components and their exact emitted-text bindings, retaining the remaining full-entry obligations.
Reference solver, numerical operations, discrete equations, independent residual certificate and actual emitted kernels are unchanged.

Existing primitive semantics and byte-source constraints are unchanged. The new guard phase representation is justified by fetched comparisons, preserved predicates and a checked physical position map. Text binding, Lean validity, scalar snapshot reasoning, concurrent admission and hardware conformance remain distinct.

results.method: Sequential memory-capped Lean module checks and full dependency audit; exact saved PTX bindings; frontend mutation tests; source/dependency/registry guards; manual semantics and theorem-premise review; receipt hashes and Stratic validation on identical final snapshots.
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 with 16 dependency pins. Heavy work sequential, one Lean thread, hard 6 GiB memory cap, swap disabled and 150 percent CPU quota. No GPU run or paid model calls.
results.evidence: 19 new modules checked with no warnings; 5008 exact declaration dependency reports use only allowed standard Lean axioms; 608 Lean source files passed guards. Native guard comparisons and branches are separately scheduled; the proved invariant derives private predicates from unchanged lane registers and rules out barrier advancement of a pending guard. Forward projection and reverse construction preserve actual memory/barrier events, all permitted arithmetic encodings, source admission, numerical correctness and memory safety. A checked map relates factored counters to 76 real instruction positions, including branch targets and barrier release. The exact zero-address-displacement renderer normalization has a proof. A complete 20-instruction setup and input loop has universal fetched scalar correctness and arbitrary-input execution existence, deriving its positive-zero initial accumulator, strided indices, two loads, separately rounded multiply/add and nonwrapping unsigned increment from actual instructions and contiguous-array bounds. No loop result, read value or execution is supplied to existence. Generic control-boundary lemmas avoid inventing a return at a barrier boundary. Uneven-tail, empty-lane, unsigned-wrap and truncated-limit Lean regressions pass. 36 hardware frontend tests pass. Saved PTX binding checks cover 180 native trees and 180 complete input programs across 30 layouts; existing bindings refreshed for 720 contractions, 630 stores, 30 residual entries and 1440 local updates. Source-identical legacy executable targets reused after hash verification, while current proof and binding audits reran. Full unchanged legacy build and interpreter suite were not rerun. Existing instruction/source semantics and README unchanged. The scalar input snapshot still needs derivation from the full concurrent entry; input/tree/tail composition, output publication and remaining PCG/host correspondence are not claimed complete. Complete PTX admission and compiler/GPU conformance remain separate. All receipt hashes and Stratic passage links match; final snapshots agree.
